scenes.vo: The apartment was cheap because nobody ever stayed. Ninth floor, unit 9C, the Halden Building. I signed the lease the same day.
On my first night, at exactly three AM, someone knocked on my door. Three slow knocks.
I crept over and looked through the peephole. The hallway was EMPTY. Just that green light, humming.
Half asleep, I leaned on the door and whispered, Who's there? Nobody answered. So I went back to bed.
At three ten, it knocked again. Lower this time. Down near the floor, like whoever it was had crouched to my height.
I pressed my eye to the peephole again. This time it was DARK. Something was covering it from the other side.
